title: Input
description: The Input component builds upon the native HTML input element and enhances it with an expanded range of field types, each associated with a specific validation pattern. You can specify the field type by utilizing the 'type' property. The Input component has access to the Form handler functions and utilities and should be used as a child in the Form component.

props.name: type
props.description: The 'type' property determines the validation pattern associated with the input element. See all available types here.

props.name: mask
props.description: The 'mask' property determines the masking pattern associated with the input element. Read more here.

props.name: validation
props.description: Overrides the native validityState error messages.

props.name: label
props.description: Label of the input field. Strongly recommended for accessibility, ensuring a more inclusive and user-friendly experience.

props.name: classes
props.type: { root: string; field: string; label: string; error: string; }
props.description: Classes applied to the root, input, label and error elements.

metaDesc: FormFusion's Input component: Powerful and customizable extention of the standard HTML input element that integrates a large library of ready to use validation rules and provides easy input masking. Easy to integrate with custom react hook allowing greater form control.
